# Project Coding Standards & Copilot Instructions

You are an expert software engineer working on this repository. Follow these guidelines for all code completions, inline edits, code reviews, and agentic tasks:

## Code Style & Architecture
- Write clean, modular, and self-documenting code with clear separation of concerns.
- Prefer explicit types and strict error handling over implicit fallbacks.
- Keep functions small, focused, and testable.

## Testing & Verification
- Every new feature or bug fix should include corresponding unit or integration tests.
- Cover edge cases, invalid inputs, and error boundaries.

## Security & Performance
- Never hardcode secrets, tokens, or credentials; always read from environment variables.
- Validate and sanitize all external inputs.
